title: Social context and motives
caption: Social categories
label: Social category
unavailable: The social categories are still being assessed for this source version.
basis: The police column contains explicit category wording, including suspicions and ongoing investigations. Narrative leads are classifications supported by the report text. Each supported record appears in one of these two columns.
formula: Share = records supporting the category ÷ all selected records. Content index = share × 100. Records without a precise location are included.
overlap: Categories can overlap. The hate and discrimination subcategories are subsets and do not add records. These figures describe selected announcements; they do not cover all crimes or measure a city’s risk.
incomplete: Uncertain and not evaluated records remain in the denominator and are shown separately; they are not counted as supported. If a new batch is still being checked, the published snapshot keeps its previous date and lists those reports as pending.
